newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman signs $2 billion LNG finance facility.
newsitem.headline: Oman signs $2 billion LNG finance facility.

text.p: Oman signed on Sunday a $2 billion finance agreement with foreign banks and export credit agencies covering downstream work at its $6 billion liquefied natural gas (LNG) project, the Oman LNG LLC said in a statement.
Seven banks arranging the loan are ABN-Ambro, National Westminister Bank Plc, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, Citibank, Banque Indosuez, Korea Exchange Bank and Gulf International Bank.
The loan is backed by UK's ECGD, Dutch NCM, US Eximbank, Italy's SACE and the U.S. OPIC, the statement said.
LNG exports from Oman to South Korea will begin in the first quarter of the year 2000.
